subject: general
question: The Guide is a 1958 novel written in English by the Indian author _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**RK Narayan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Guide__ is a novel written by the __Indian author__, __R. K. Narayan__.
 
• It was published in 1958.
 
• The novel **focuses on the protagonist, a tour guide and his journey to becoming a spiritual guide.**
 
• The novel won the **Sahitya Akademi Award in 1960.**
 
• It was also adapted into the **film **"Guide" released in **1965 **and **starred Waheeda Rehman and Dev Anand.**
